name: Data for Generative AI Improvement setting
plain: A LinkedIn account setting that controls using member content to train AI models.
meaning: Posts, profile data and job application data can train content-generating models. The toggle is forward looking; it cannot undo past training.

android.prompt_ui: Setting in the app and on the web
android.revocation: Profile > Settings > Data privacy > Data for Generative AI Improvement

ios.prompt_ui: Setting in the app and on the web
ios.revocation: Profile > Settings > Data privacy > Data for Generative AI Improvement

data.metric: Use my data for training content creation AI models

limits.headline: Can use your posts and profile to train AI unless you switch the setting off
limits.user_action: You open Settings and turn Data for Generative AI Improvement on or off
can: Use posts, profile and job application data to train content making AI
Follow your setting from the time you switch it, in the app and on the web
cannot: Undo training that already happened when you switch it off
Use your data for training after you turn it off, going forward

story.what_it_is: A LinkedIn setting that decides whether your posts and profile can train AI models.
story.for_you: In your LinkedIn privacy settings there is a switch for using your data to improve generative AI. It is on by default in many regions. You can turn it off, but past use is not undone.
story.for_makers: AI features need lots of real text. Member posts, profiles and job info are rich training material. The setting lets LinkedIn say people can opt out, while it keeps the data flowing by default.

use_cases.example: A writing assistant drafts a LinkedIn post using models trained on member content.
A recruiter tool suggests job descriptions learned from real postings.
A resume helper learns what good profiles look like.
An ad tool writes copy tuned to what members respond to.
A fraud team trains spam and fake profile detectors.
A skills model learns which jobs link to which skills.
A feed model learns what content people like.

risks: Profile text may appear in outputs
story.android_note: The setting works the same in the Android LinkedIn app.
story.ios_note: The setting works the same in the iPhone LinkedIn app.

technical_bounds: Does not cover feedback data; a separate objection form exists for other AI uses

linkedin.how: Default on for members outside excluded regions from Sept 2024 (opt-out was hidden). From 3 Nov 2025 the updated notice applies to Designated Countries and UK; LinkedIn says opting out is forward looking. Same setting in mobile Settings; the help page has no mobile specific steps.

history.change: Setting appeared on by default for most regions; EEA and Switzerland excluded; UK paused after ICO contact
Setting extended to EU, EEA, UK, Switzerland, Canada and Hong Kong from 3 Nov 2025 under the updated privacy notice
